title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisional Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Public Security Administrative Cases by People's Courts
keywords_en: People's Court adjudication of public security administrative cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Provisional Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law by People's Courts in Hearing Public Security Administrative Cases

Fa (Yan) Fa [1986] No. 31

To all local people's courts at various levels nationwide:

We hereby issue to you the Provisional Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law by People's Courts in Hearing Public Security Administrative Cases, formulated by our court. These Regulations shall come into effect as of the effective date of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Administrative Penalties for Public Security. Any opinions or problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to our court.

Attachment: Provisional Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law by People's Courts in Hearing Public Security Administrative Cases

October 24, 1986

Provisional Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law by People's Courts in Hearing Public Security Administrative Cases

The Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Administrative Penalties for Public Security were adopted at the Seventeenth Session of the Standing Committee of the Sixth National People's Congress on September 5, 1986. Article 39 of the said Regulations provides: "A person who is subject to a public security administrative penalty or an aggrieved party who is dissatisfied with a ruling made by a public security organ or a people's government of a township (or town) may, within five days after receiving the notice, file an appeal with the public security organ at the next higher level, which shall make a ruling within five days after receiving the appeal; if dissatisfied with the ruling of the public security organ at the next higher level, the person may, within five days after receiving the notice, bring a lawsuit in the local people's court." To properly try public security administrative cases, the following provisional regulations are hereby formulated.

1. A public security administrative case shall generally be under the jurisdiction of the basic people's court in the locality where the public security organ or the people's government of the township (or town) that first made the ruling is located. In accordance with legal provisions, when necessary, a basic people's court may, with respect to a case under its jurisdiction, report it to a higher people's court for trial; a higher people's court shall have the authority to try a case under the jurisdiction of a basic people's court.

Public security administrative cases involving foreign elements shall be under the jurisdiction of the intermediate people's court.

When accepting a public security administrative case, the people's court shall notify the public security organ that made the last ruling to respond to the lawsuit. The public security organ that made the last ruling may designate the public security organ that made the original ruling to respond to the lawsuit.

2. When trying a public security administrative case, the people's court shall adopt a collegial panel system; if the facts of the case are simple, it may be tried by a single judge.

If a party is dissatisfied with the ruling of the people's court, it may, within five days, apply to the next higher people's court for a single review.

3. When trying a public security administrative case involving a penalty of detention, the people's court shall render a ruling within ten days after acceptance; when trying a public security administrative case involving a penalty of a fine or a warning, the people's court shall render a ruling within twenty days after acceptance.

The people's court reviewing the public security administrative case shall notify the parties of the review result within ten days.

For cases with special circumstances that cannot be concluded upon expiration of the time limit, an extension of ten days may be granted upon approval by the next higher people's court.

4. The people's court shall only conduct a review of whether the last ruling of the public security organ is consistent with the facts and whether it is lawful, and shall render a ruling to uphold or revoke the ruling in accordance with the law, as the case may be.

5. When accepting a public security administrative case, in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), the plaintiff shall prepay litigation costs at an amount of five yuan to thirty yuan per case. Upon conclusion of the trial, the litigation costs shall be borne by the losing party. Any application by the plaintiff for deferral, reduction, or waiver of payment shall be examined and decided by the people's court.
